facts.fact: NITDA issued the Nigeria e-Government Interoperability Framework (Ne-GIF), release v1.2 of August 2019 (v1.0 May 2018), under section 6(a) and (c) of the NITDA Act 2007, as the baseline framework for how MDAs' systems exchange data.
The Ne-GIF lists its enforcement category as Recommended, not Mandatory, and section 4.5 states that compliance cannot be compelled, only encouraged, and that enforceable guidelines are still needed.
